action.code: const scene = window.__THREE_SCENE__; const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster(); const mouse = new THREE.Vector2(0, 0); const ground = scene.children.find(c => c.geometry && c.geometry.type.includes('Plane')); if (ground) { raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, window.__THREE_CAMERA__); const intersects = raycaster.intersectObject(ground); if (intersects.length > 0) { for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { ground.dispatchEvent({type: 'click'}); } } }

postconditions: 3 energy orbs spawned on ground plane

action.code: const scene = window.__THREE_SCENE__; const orbs = scene.children.filter(c => c.userData && c.userData.isEnergyOrb); const fragments = scene.children.filter(c => c.userData && c.userData.isHelmetFragment); if (orbs.length >= 2 && fragments.length >= 2) { for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) { if (orbs[i] && fragments[i]) { orbs[i].position.copy(fragments[i].position); orbs[i].dispatchEvent({type: 'dragend', fragment: fragments[i]}); } } }

postconditions: charged fragments glow brighter and scaled up 10%

action.code: const scene = window.__THREE_SCENE__; const fragments = scene.children.filter(c => c.userData && c.userData.isHelmetFragment && c.userData.charged); if (fragments.length >= 2) { fragments[0].dispatchEvent({type: 'click'}); setTimeout(() => { if (fragments[1]) fragments[1].dispatchEvent({type: 'click'}); }, 500); }

const scene = window.__THREE_SCENE__; const ground = scene.children.find(c => c.geometry && c.geometry.type.includes('Plane')); if (ground) { for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { ground.dispatchEvent({type: 'click'}); } } setTimeout(() => { const orbs = scene.children.filter(c => c.userData && c.userData.isEnergyOrb); const fragments = scene.children.filter(c => c.userData && c.userData.isHelmetFragment && !c.userData.charged); for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(3, orbs.length, fragments.length); i++) { if (orbs[i] && fragments[i]) { orbs[i].position.copy(fragments[i].position); orbs[i].dispatchEvent({type: 'dragend', fragment: fragments[i]}); } } }, 1000); setTimeout(() => { const chargedFrags = scene.children.filter(c => c.userData && c.userData.isHelmetFragment && c.userData.charged && !c.userData.activated); chargedFrags.forEach((f, idx) => { setTimeout(() => f.dispatchEvent({type: 'click'}), idx * 300); }); }, 2500);

postconditions: All 5 fragments activated in correct clockwise order
Helmet fully assembled and equipped on Michelle's head

action.code: if (window.__3D_STATE__.repairHistoryLength > 0 && window.__3D_STATE__.currentHistoryIndex !== undefined) { const undoBtn = document.querySelector('[data-action="undo"]'); const redoBtn = document.querySelector('[data-action="redo"]'); if (undoBtn) { undoBtn.click(); setTimeout(() => { if (redoBtn) redoBtn.click(); }, 500); } }

postconditions: task complete with optimal repair path
